1.title: Trump Threatens Defamation Suit Over National Guard Report, Aiming to Intimidate a Critic
1.summary: It was the latest example of President Trump’s bid to use the legal system against those who voice unflattering facts and opinions generally protected by the First Amendment.

2.title: U.S. Citizen Who Deleted Phone’s Data Says His Prosecution Puts Privacy at Risk
2.summary: Samuel Tunick, who faces a felony charge for deleting his phone’s data during an airport customs search, called the government’s peering into people’s private lives “creepy.”

3.title: How Penn State students ran an alleged cocaine ring - until it all fell apart
3.summary: As initiation, prospective fraternity members were made to package the drugs, say prosecutors.

4.title: Several injured after sword attack at Swedish school
4.summary: Police say one man has been arrested, while several other local schools have been locked down.

5.title: Why China Thinks It Can Resist Trump’s Economic Threats on Iran
5.summary: Beijing can squeeze U.S. critical mineral supplies and has enough oil to withstand the loss of Iranian crude, Chinese analysts say.

6.title: At 77, She Walked 9 Miles Under Drone-Filled Skies to Escape From ‘Hell’
6.summary: Rescue teams no longer enter the city of Lyman, in eastern Ukraine, because it is deemed too dangerous. The only way out is a terrifying journey on foot.
